fields.name: Main Purpose / Request
fields.expected: Expressing support for dual-naming the East Sea / Sea of Japan in school textbooks and committing to back legislation as Governor.
fields.predicted: Terry McAuliffe expresses support for the Korean Community of Virginia's efforts to have Virginia school textbooks label the body of water known as the East Sea or the Sea of Japan with both names. He pledges that as Governor, he will support legislation to ensure new textbooks reflect this historical truth, referencing legislation introduced by Democratic Senator Dave Marsden in 2012.
